notes.title: Wholesome Demos We’re Loving This Next
notes.content:
[h2] If you enjoyed our demos, we think you’ll feel right at home with [i]Gemporium: A Cute Mining Sim[/i], [i]KuloNiku: Bowl Up![/i], and [i]Ship, Inc.[/i][/h2]
[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289937/27c37c3d3f914b0393b1cafec28831a1600ca93c.png[/img]

Hey Cafe Owner,
We’ve been sipping tea and diving into some lovely Next Fest demos, and we think these three feel just like a warm hug. If you’ve played our demos, these gems might be your next cozy favorites 💛

[h2][b]Gemporium: A Cute Mining Sim[/b][/h2]
Dig up shiny treasures, polish them to perfection, and run your very own gem shop. It’s a chill little sim where every sparkle tells a story.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836100/Gemporium_A_Cute_Mining_Sim?snr=1_5_9_


[h2][b]KuloNiku: Bowl Up![/b][/h2]
 Sling meatballs and chaos in this fast-paced, comedic cooking game! Meet hilarious locals, cook wild orders, and rise to the top of the town’s food chain.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3357960/KuloNiku_Bowl_Up?snr=1_5_9_


[h2][b]Ship, Inc.[/b][/h2]
Wrap, pack, and send parcels with love in this relaxing job sim. Upgrade your tiny office into a shipping sanctuary, one cozy delivery at a time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3496000/Ship_Inc?snr=1_5_9_


Brew up most heart warming coffee get comfy and give them a try ☕💼✨
